en: \[VSCode] Changed Claude in Chrome to ask before browser actions in every session, including one connected with `@browser`, as the terminal does; allowing a site for the session stops repeat asks
zh: \[VSCode] 变更 Claude in Chrome：与终端一致，在每个 session 中执行浏览器操作前都会先询问，包括通过 `@browser` 连接的 session；为某个站点在本次 session 中授权后不再重复询问
